name: hub_levels
description: 0.9.0's levels in the hub (release page, Hard and Very Hard): offline, a party of one, High Water. Beside the mode line Normal · Hard · Very Hard; a click on Hard lights it and the mode line names it, as 0.8.0's line (above) never could; the picture is the mode line alone, at its own size. Then Very Hard hovered: its tooltip says what it changes, as the page's table does. The old build has no words to click, so its steps only open the hub.

steps.assert: node('ModeLine').text == 'High Water · Hard · 1–4 players · 12 waves' and node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal | Hard (lit) | Very Hard'
steps.msg: Hard lit, and the mode line names it

steps.assert: node('Level_very_hard').tooltip_text == 'Very Hard: creeps have 15% more health, the bosses 55% more and 1 more armour; 10 lives'
